title: The three normalization properties of the actual Kummer coefficients
statement: For the actual coefficient record strictKummerNormalizationCoefficients [def-sfb-kummer-pure-kernel-normalization-statement], with ell prime and invertible on W, the Kernel and FiniteLift properties hold. For every derived reduction D and quotient-normalized evaluated units eta, its PureTriangles property holds. Kernel is the signed distinguished Kummer triangle with actual roots and actual root transitions. FiniteLift lifts prescribed underlying finite Tate isomorphisms and fixes root normalization. PureTriangles is precisely the arbitrary-sheaf pure-evaluation triangle computation applied to comparison units; it constructs no pure comparison.

proof.text: Expand the actual record Kernel property and apply the proved Kummer triangle and root-transition theorem. Every projected coefficient is the original explicit parameter.
Expand PureTriangles; for each supplied H and b apply the arbitrary-sheaf pure-evaluation triangle theorem to the actual M field. No H or b is constructed.
Expand FiniteLift and apply the proved ordinary finite-lifting theorem with the actual coefficient parameters.
